description:
Signed ``(seq, head, tick, count)`` from the separate witness process; one line per tick in ``witness.jsonl``.
No-op ticks repeat ``(seq, head)`` with a new ``count``. Stall (F6): the gateway waits to the deadline,
proceeds and raises a ``witness_stall`` alert; heads live in ``<run>/witness-heads/`` (0700, witness uid).

count.description: Signed line counter (B1/F2): 1 on the first line, +1 per line, strictly; the RunAnchor repeats the last.
count.title: Count

seq.description: Seq of the record whose hash is ``head``.
seq.title: Seq

sig.description: Witness Ed25519 over :meth:`signing_bytes`. ``None`` only before signing.
sig.title: Sig

witness_id.description: Witness principal (``ks.witness``); its key is not the gateway's.
witness_id.title: Witness Id

title: WitnessCheckpoint
